optionsConsentLabel.message: Allow external analysis (data transmission to third parties)

optionsConsentHelpPart2.message: hashes, files, links or IP addresses are transmitted to external services. Only after you gave your consent can attachments, links and metadata be sent for analysis to Hybrid Analysis, VirusTotal, urlscan.io, URLhaus or AbuseIPDB – depending on the privacy tier. You can revoke the consent at any time by turning this option off. Details:

optionsAutoScanLabel.message: Check links of the email right away when it is opened (auto scan)

optionsAutoScanHelp.message: When disabled, a link is only checked at the moment you click it (time-of-click protection).

optionsTocLabel.message: Mark links in the message text and check them on click (time-of-click protection)

optionsTocHelp.message: Links are checked when you click them. A link that is known to be malicious or whose check fails is blocked; you can still open it from the notice. Schemes that cannot be checked (e.g. file:, ftp:) are blocked as well.

optionsAboutText.message:
Hybrid-Analysis.com is a free malware analysis service for the community. With this service you can submit files for detailed static and dynamic analysis.

The website uses a unique hybrid analysis technology to detect and analyse unknown threats. It is powered by the Falcon Sandbox from CrowdStrike.

The Falcon Sandbox is a state of the art malware analysis framework with a very agile architecture. It is used by SOCs, CERTs, DFIR teams, IT security forensics labs, researchers and threat intelligence providers around the world.
